maddeler.e:
انضربت (form VII)
# اِنْضَرَبْتُ (inḍarabtu) /in.dˤa.rab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# اِنْضَرَبْتَ (inḍarabta) /in.dˤa.rab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# اِنْضَرَبْتِ (inḍarabti) /in.dˤa.rab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# اِنْضَرَبَتْ (inḍarabat) /in.dˤa.ra.bat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
